title: Apple shares drop on iPhone suppliers' warnings
text: Apple shares drop on iPhone suppliers' warnings Monday, 12 November 2018 ( 1 hour ago ) Apple Inc shares fell to their lowest in more than three months on Monday as three suppliers issued warnings on results that pointed to weakness in iPhone sales. ▶ Stocks Weaken Amid Tech Nerves 00:47 According to Reuters, The U.S. dollar surged on Monday to its highest point in 16 months against a basket of currencies and world stocks fell broadly amid concern about political risks in Europe, while a drop in Apple shares added pressure to U.S. equities and tech shares.
